Privacy Policy

How QSC handles your details when you contact or book.

  1. Home
  2. Privacy Policy
Draft pending legal review: this text is to be completed and approved by QSC's legal counsel under the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law before launch.

What we collect

When you request an appointment we collect only what you give us: your name, mobile number, vehicle details, a description of the issue and any photos you attach — for the single purpose of responding to your request and providing the service.

How it is used

Your details go to the relevant workshop team to process your request. We do not sell data or share it with marketing parties, and photos of your vehicle are never used in any public material without your documented consent.

Analytics

Aggregate measurement tools help us understand site usage (for example, taps on the call button). Personal form data and photo contents are never logged to analytics.

Contact

For any question about your data, email info@qscco.sa.
